crossRefs.note: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

parallels.note: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

translations.web: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
translations.bsb: The man brought John’s head on a platter and presented it to the girl, who gave it to her mother.
translations.kjv: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
translations.asv: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the damsel; and the damsel gave it to her mother.
